subject.title: fix: require admin for keyed session model changes [AI]

question: Should existing write-scoped gateway clients be intentionally prevented from changing model or thinking selection on an adopted explicit session key, requiring `operator.admin` instead?
rationale: This is both a privilege-boundary hardening choice and an upgrade-visible behavioral break for existing automation; source review cannot determine the intended permanent authorization contract.

options.title: Approve the admin boundary
options.body: Keep write scope for fresh and idempotent keyed-session requests, require admin for an existing row’s changed model or thinking selection, and require final-head proof before merge.

options.title: Preserve existing write behavior
options.body: Retain write-scoped model selection for existing keyed sessions and pursue a narrower security boundary only if a distinct unsafe mutation can be identified.

recommendation.title: Approve the admin boundary
recommendation.body: Keep write scope for fresh and idempotent keyed-session requests, require admin for an existing row’s changed model or thinking selection, and require final-head proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the current implementation context, while repository-history ownership could not be resolved in the read-only inspection environment.
